headline: Trung Nam Thuan Nam Solar Power reports half-year loss for 2026
summary: Trung Nam Thuan Nam Solar Power (TNSC) reported a post-tax loss for the first six months of 2026. It made a profit of over VND 126 billion in the same period last year, according to its filing to the Hanoi Stock Exchange.
why: Trung Nam Thuan Nam Solar Power is a Vietnamese solar power producer, and its half-year results give investors a read on the financial health of Vietnam's renewable energy sector.
